The '''Frog-dogs''' were a [[Huttball/Legends|Huttball]] team who played against the [[Rotworms]]. The game took place in [[The Pit (arena)|the Pit]], an arena on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="HB">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/huttball|text=Trailer - Huttball}}</ref>
